changes: archive.py adds validated keyword-only gzip compression and per-file memory staging limits, retaining the original defaults of level 9 and 8 MiB. The configurable memory limit is capped at 128 MiB, stages only one ordinary file at a time, and keeps SQLite and larger files on NAS scratch. Source safety checks, archive verification, and publication are unchanged. restore.py and prepare.py remain unmodified reviewed upstream helpers.
